def gripper_quat(closing_yaw: float, approach=(0.0, 0.0, -1.0)) -> np.ndarray:
    """Tip orientation (wxyz) whose fingers close along the horizontal direction `closing_yaw` (rad, world x->y) and whose
    approach axis (gripper base -> fingertips) points along `approach` (default straight down). Measured tip-frame
    convention of the Pika grippers: local +z = approach axis, local +x = finger closing axis."""
    c = np.array([math.cos(closing_yaw), math.sin(closing_yaw), 0.0])
    a = np.asarray(approach, dtype=np.float64); a = a - a.dot(c) * c
    if np.linalg.norm(a) < 1e-6:

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Generate a replayable trajectory for the frozen collect_screws instance."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from rcb_robowits import Session
+
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output")
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+s = Session("collect_screws", instance="/app/instance.json")
+p = s.primitives()
+
+# Pinch the screw from above, lift it clear of the table, and release it over
+# the center of the container. The frozen instance makes these poses repeatable.
+s.reset()
+s.record_start()
+grasp_quat = p["top_down_quat"](1.5707963267948966)
+
+p["move_ee"]("right", [0.3829, -0.2078, 0.88], grasp_quat, linear=5)
+p["move_ee"]("right", [0.3829, -0.2078, 0.775], grasp_quat, linear=5)
+p["close_gripper"]("right", steps=25)
+p["hold"](10)
+
+p["move_ee"]("right", [0.3829, -0.2078, 0.93], grasp_quat, linear=5)
+p["hold"](8)
+p["move_ee"]("right", [0.58, 0.0, 0.97], grasp_quat, linear=10)
+p["move_ee"]("right", [0.58, 0.0, 0.91], grasp_quat, linear=4)
+p["open_gripper"]("right", steps=20)
+p["move_ee"]("right", [0.58, 0.0, 1.02], grasp_quat, linear=5)
+p["hold"](120)
+
+actions = s.record_stop()
+status = s.replay(actions)
+print("replay:", status)
+if not status["success"]:
+    raise RuntimeError("Generated trajectory did not complete the task")
+
+s.save_trajectory(
+    actions,
+    OUT / "trajectory.npz",
+    meta={"method": "right-arm top-down pinch and transfer", "steps": len(actions)},
+)
+print(f"saved {len(actions)} actions to {OUT / 'trajectory.npz'}")
*** End Patch";
